Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing a local tax on admission and parking charges for events at community stadiums.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to community stadiums; adding a new section tochapter 35.21 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that communitystadiums provide a venue for wholesome, affordable, familyorientedactivities, including minor league baseball. The legislature intendsto provide local governments with assistance to ensure that theseimportant venues remain available to Washington citizens.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislative authority of a city or town in which a minorleague baseball team plays in a community stadium may impose a tax ofup to one cent on twenty cents or fraction thereof to be paid by theperson who pays an admission charge to the events in the minor leaguebaseball stadium. The tax authorized in this section may also beimposed on any parking charges or fees imposed in parking facilitiesassociated with the community stadium. The revenue generated by thetax imposed in this section shall be used solely for the purpose of p. 1 HB 2288paying for the operation, maintenance, repair, rehabilitation,financing, equipping, and reequipping of a community stadium andassociated parking facilities. The tax authorized in this section isin addition to any other taxes on admission levied by the city. (2) "Community stadium" is any public facility existing and in useon the effective date of this act which provides a venue for communityevents and may have a minor league baseball team affiliated with amajor league baseball club operating in it for at least a portion ofthe previous two years.
